name: Breadbox
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. that inhabits vending machines and maintenance closets in transit stations, keeping them stocked with 'misrouted' food items that were diverted from corporate waste streams.
observed_behavior: Intercepts automated restocking orders for corporate waste disposal and redirects viable food products to publicly accessible locations.
story_hooks: A transit worker opens a maintenance closet and finds a week's worth of perfectly good Tessera cafeteria food that nobody ordered
